name: 169-human-gate-with-command
note: Synthetic shape built from the incident in issue 169 (the original run data was not retained). Sam first returns a human-gate item that also carries the command deciding it in its structured command field (the node -e render of the incident); the base plan check accepts it, the engine must refuse it before any plan-check call and loop back to Sam, whose second answer drops the human gate. A command written only in an item text is judged by the plan-check model, not by the engine, so it is not replayed here. Sam answers hold both the legacy plan text with its checklist lines and the acceptanceItems entries, so the same fixture is valid for the base engine and the branch. plan-check-169-1 is answered CONFORMING on purpose: the base reaches it, the branch never does.

args.brief: a human-gate item must not carry a command
